title: ?author= filter is non-functional on a live server (no wrap-params)
evidence: src/book_api/core.clj:26 reads (get-in req [:params :author]); the handler stack at src/book_api/core.clj:44 is (-> app-routes wrap-json-response (wrap-json-body ...)) with NO ring.middleware.params/wrap-params. grep for wrap-params/query-params across src test deps.edn returns nothing. Compojure merges only route-params into :params, and /books has no route params, so the query-string 'author' lands in :query-string and :params :author is always nil. db/all-books (src/book_api/db.clj:34-43) supports the filter but is only ever reached with nil, returning ALL books.
suggestion: Add (wrap-params) from ring.middleware.params to the handler stack (or read (get-in req [:query-params "author"]) after wrap-params), then confirm against a live server.

title: author-filter test passes vacuously and does not verify R3
evidence: test/book_api/core_test.clj:26 asserts (= 1 (count (:body (request :get "/books?author=Frank%20Herbert")))). The test helper (test/book_api/core_test.clj:10-13) places the query string inside :uri, not :query-string, so Compojure/clout fails to match /books and returns the not-found map {:error "Not found"}, whose count is 1 — so the assertion passes regardless of whether filtering works. This is why the broken R3 filter still scored test_coverage=1.0.
suggestion: Drive the request with a real :query-string and wrap-params, and assert on the returned book titles rather than a count that a 1-key error map also satisfies.
